---
title: Why Typst matters
---

## Overview

Explore why Typst deserves a place on your radar, with concrete "quick wins" that show how it can dramatically simplify PDF generation.

## Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, you will be able to:

* Describe what Typst is and how it differs from LaTeX-based PDF generation.
* Render Quarto documents to PDF via Typst and customize their appearance.
* Apply Typst "quick wins" to solve common PDF layout problems that are painful in LaTeX.
* Decide when Typst is the right choice for a PDF workflow.
